name: wlanpi-mcp-extension
description: Connect Claude to one or more WLAN Pi devices running wlanpi-mcp.
long_description: Lets Claude use your WLAN Pis for Wi-Fi diagnostics: device info, services, Wi-Fi scans, packet capture, profiler, Bluetooth and more, through each Pi's wlanpi-mcp server. Add a Pi by asking Claude, for example "add my WLAN Pi at 10.0.0.5". Each Pi's self-signed certificate is pinned on first use, and a changed certificate is refused until you confirm it. With several Pis, every tool takes a device argument naming the Pi to use. Runs on your computer and talks only to the Pis you add.

tools.name: add_wlanpi
tools.description: Register a WLAN Pi by hostname or IP and pin its certificate.

tools.name: list_wlanpis
tools.description: List registered WLAN Pis and whether each answers.

tools.name: trust_wlanpi_cert
tools.description: Re-pin a WLAN Pi's certificate after it legitimately changed.

tools.name: set_wlanpi_token
tools.description: Set or replace a WLAN Pi's wlanpi-core token.

seed_devices.title: WLAN Pis to add at startup
seed_devices.description: Optional. Comma-separated name=host pairs, e.g. lab=10.0.0.5, field=wlanpi-7.local. Each is added once, pinning its certificate on first contact. You can also just ask Claude to add a Pi.

default_token.title: wlanpi-core token
default_token.description: Optional. Token used for Pis added without one, so it never appears in your conversation. Get it on the Pi with: sudo getjwt claude

ca_file.title: CA certificate
ca_file.description: Optional. Only if your Pis use certificates from your own CA: validate against this CA instead of pinning each Pi's certificate.
